candidates.name: Authority-Gated Predictive Transducer
candidates.reason: Recombines the existing carrier-conditioned effect transport, explicit operation-bijection transport, and the preregistered acquisition-derivative estimand without a distinct executable update law.

candidates.name: Capacity-Limited Applicability Atlas
candidates.reason: Its broad algorithmic axes recur in task-similarity kernel meta-learning, limited-memory continual learning, transfer-gain prediction, and learning-progress curricula. More decisively, the frozen ARC evidence contains only one independently task-credited positive episode, so no target-morphism topology or local negative-transfer boundary is identifiable.

candidates.name: Delayed Counterfactual Settlement Loop
candidates.reason: Repackages the existing two-stage eligibility and delayed-settlement mechanisms around a later child-acquisition label without a new causal carrier or discriminator available in the frozen evidence.

information_gain.rejected_claim: A new persistent schema-selection module is currently justified by the one positive ARC option episode.
information_gain.surviving_constraint: A reusable abstraction requires independently varied task-credit positives and matched descendants before its invariant and applicability boundary can be identified.
information_gain.next_discriminator: Attempt to add a task-credited episode on a distinct ARC game with a persistent unchanged Sol-max actor and complete exchange persistence; success raises positive intervention rank but does not establish transfer.

claim_boundary: H118 rejects all three generated correspondences under the frozen criteria. It does not show that acquisition derivatives, task-morphism charts, or delayed settlement are useless; it shows that adding those mechanisms now would outrun both novelty evidence and ARC identifiability.
